scoring.title: How confidence and priority were calculated
scoring.ratio: Observed out/in ratio: {ratio}. This is not a retained-funds or balance measure.
scoring.dates: Dates: {dates}. No time-of-day ordering is available.
scoring.matches: Matched rules: {rules}. Highest base score wins; ties: coordinator, consolidator, distributor, transit, terminal, peripheral. Subtract 0.10 for multiple matches; multiply by 0.60 at depth 4, then 0.85 for seeds.
scoring.contributions: Priority contributions (sum = priority; seed membership adds no priority):
scoring.rules: Rules: consolidator ≥3 incoming and ≥2× outgoing peers; distributor ≥5 outgoing and ≥2× incoming; coordinator ≥2 each direction and ≥3 neighbor communities; transit non-seed, both directions, ratio 0.8–1.2; terminal non-seed, depth<4, incoming but no outgoing peers. Otherwise peripheral.
scoring.formula: Priority = 0.30×min(incoming peers/10,1) + 0.25×min(outgoing peers/10,1) + 0.20×min(cross-community peers/5,1) + 0.15×min((incoming+outgoing transfers)/30,1) + 0.10×log(1+incoming+outgoing KZT)/log(1+maximum incident KZT in this dataset).
rule.coordinator: At least 2 incoming and 2 outgoing peers across at least 3 neighbor communities.
rule.consolidator: At least 3 incoming peers, at least twice the outgoing peer count.
rule.distributor: At least 5 outgoing peers, at least twice the incoming peer count.
rule.transit: Non-seed; incoming and outgoing peers; observed out/in ratio 0.8–1.2; at least 80% of external incoming KZT matched to outgoing amounts 1–2 calendar days later (FIFO, no reuse).
rule.terminal: Incoming peers but no observed outgoing peers below depth 4; not a seed. Candidate endpoint only.
rule.peripheral: No stronger rule matched; insufficient structural evidence, not a judgment about the customer.

cluster.fanOut: Fan-out example {gid}: peers in/out={incoming}/{outgoing}, observed KZT in/out={inKzt}/{outKzt}.
cluster.bridges: Potential bridging accounts={count} (incoming and outgoing peers in different communities).
cluster.bridgeExample: Bridging example {gid}: {communities} neighbor communities, {peers} cross-community peers; this does not trace the same funds.
cluster.noPattern: No measured fan-in, fan-out or bridging pattern meets these thresholds.
cluster.caveats: Depth-four boundary accounts={boundary}; onward transfers unknown. Seeds={seeds}; incoming flows outside the sample are missing. Patterns use all observed peers, including outside this community. July 2026 outgoing-only collection, four hops, intra-bank ≥5,000 KZT; smaller transfers and other banks are absent. Observed flows are not balances. Grouping is not proof of an organization.

temporal.title: Timing of observed transfers
temporal.matched: Matched after 1–2 days: {amount} KZT ({share} of incoming amounts). After 1 day: {day1}; after 2 days: {day2} KZT.
temporal.sameDay: Same-day overlap: {amount} KZT. Order within the day is unknown; excluded from transit evidence. This separate measure must not be added to matched amounts.
temporal.caveat: Daily FIFO allocation, excluding self-transfers. Each amount is used once within this account’s allocation. This is temporal compatibility, not proof of the same money moving onward. Unobserved flows and the four-hop boundary limit conclusions.
temporal.endWindow: Incomplete two-day observation window for {amount} KZT received on the last two days of July. These amounts remain in the denominator; missing later transfers do not disprove transit.
pattern.title: Observed patterns
pattern.collection: Collection from many: {incoming} incoming counterparties, {outgoing} outgoing (at least 3 incoming and at least twice as many as outgoing).
pattern.transit: Fast transit: {amount} KZT ({share} of non-self incoming amounts) matched to spending 1–2 days later; threshold 80%.
pattern.distribution: Distribution: {outgoing} outgoing counterparties, {incoming} incoming (at least 5 outgoing and at least twice as many as incoming).
pattern.none: None of these three pattern thresholds is met. This does not establish absence of other behavior.
pattern.caveat: Patterns can coexist and do not replace the primary role. They describe observed data, not confirmed intent or fund identity. Missing flows and collection boundaries limit interpretation.
